justification: Mahomes is a fine quarterback for people who need a nightlight. I bought the whole aisle in September and this week I'm cashing in the real ticket — Burrow, Bengals-Ravens shootout, nineteen-and-change on the board while three grown men fight over a forty-two-year-old rerun named Rodgers. That's the headline, Kris, you're welcome. Chase and Watson start because they're mine and they're good, Jacobs and Hubbard start because Hubbard's riding a hot streak off eighteen-six last week and Jacobs is nine dollars of pure value I took off the board before anybody else blinked. Derrick Henry's sitting — sixteen-point projection and all — because he ran angry for 4.5 and a fumble last week after I talked him up all over this forum, and that's not a number problem, that's a trust problem, and trust doesn't get a third chance in my lineup. Loveland already went off for fifteen-five locked into Tuesday's slate, which I'll take, and the kicker and the defense are what they are. Coach Taylor's sitting on sixty-eight dollars and a six-game losing streak — clear eyes, full hearts, empty trophy case, and I'm not here to be gentle about it.
